تمتنعين (form VIII)
# تَمْتَنِعِينَ (tamtaniʕīna) /tam.ta.ni.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
# تُمْتَنَعِينَ (tumtanaʕīna) /tum.ta.na.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
